infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: QuoteCraft uses the camera to photograph receipts and job photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: QuoteCraft lets you attach receipt and job photos from your library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: QuoteCraft records voice notes and client meetings when you ask it to.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: QuoteCraft records when you arrive at and leave a job site so your work hours are counted automatically. Your location is not tracked anywhere else.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: QuoteCraft uses your location to confirm you are at the job site when you start and finish work.
